recommendation: Keep this core audit commit. If the Security WG still intends the Jira/minutes wording literally, update the FHIR Extension Pack auditevent-Lifecycle Extension.value[x] binding from preferred to example in a separate extension-pack change.
issue_request: FHIR-32470 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to remove AuditEvent.entity.lifecycle because lifecycle-event codes were not suitable for an extensible binding on a lifecycle-state element, and to create auditevent-Lifecycle with an example binding to DICOM lifecycle codes.
initial_application: Core commit c91fb9ed1f9e262b7b3f67cd79ed8d20ec643fb6 removed AuditEvent.entity.lifecycle and added auditevent-Lifecycle. The added extension used preferred binding strength, while Jira and Security WG minutes describe example binding.
additional_context: The current core source keeps AuditEvent active, omits AuditEvent.entity.lifecycle, maps the deleted R4/R6 element to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/auditevent-Lifecycle, and no longer contains the extension definition after dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed AuditEvent extensions from core. The current auditevent-Lifecycle source is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions and still uses preferred binding strength.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core source change was made because the base AuditEvent resource already reflects the removal and the remaining correction, if pursued, belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack repository.
